描述_EN: the neck and sleeves have similar embroidery. the robe is of scarlet satin, heavily embroidered in gold thread. the hem has a deep border of wave pattern. robe for an actor (theatre costume). at either side of the front panel is a strip of royal blue satin, embroidered in gold thread. in the centre of the front is a large dragon, and below are two other dragons, a temple, and various small designs.
描述_ZN: 脖子和袖子上有类似的刺绣。 该袍子是猩红色的缎子，用金线大量刺绣。 下摆有一个波浪纹的深边。 演员的袍子（戏剧服装）。 在前面板的两侧有一条皇家蓝色的缎子，用金线绣成。 正面中央是一条大龙，下面是另外两条龙，一座寺庙，以及各种小图案。
